applies_why: This judge text evaluates whether verses on D2 vs C3 count toward a broken link under K-G4 and whether a retraction cures that count.
quote: RESULT: UNCURED; WHY: no PRESSED line, no RETRACTED line, and no statement that names a pressing round and quotes it, for D2 vs C3; malformed line: RETRACTED: D2 vs C3 -- the challenger's own later rounds quoted and answered the witnesses
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: The phrase 'Not counting it obeys this rule' with 'counts as an unanswered witness': I read not counting an answered verse as allowed without a formal PRESSED/RETRACTED line; the contrary reading requires a pressed-line quote even for a retraction.
why: The judge marks the line UNCURED and calls the retraction malformed for lacking a PRESSED line, even while saying the witnesses were answered and no link is broken, contrary to K-G4's direction that not counting an answered verse obeys.
